purpose: What a buyer can rely on before paying a Kognai agent: how payment is collected, what is delivered, what is never claimed.

facts: Golden Kog gives facts, not advice: risk and structure read on chain, never a buy or sell signal and never investment advice.
Pay on delivery on Base: the authorization is verified at once and collected only when the image, video or report is delivered; a failed job is not charged.
Solana is settled up front (a Solana transaction expires in about a minute); a failed job leaves a recorded refund owed.
Every Kreativ image and video passes a quality reviewer before delivery.
No account and no key: the x402 payment is the credential.
Prices here are the amounts of the live 402 offers, network fee included; a test fails the build when they differ.
Every settled payment is answered with its transaction hash (the transaction field and the PAYMENT-RESPONSE header) and booked as a receipt.
Kognai never asks for keys or seed phrases.
